purpose: Decide whether currently frozen public and project-created sources can support the primary temporal executable aggregate without weakening the preregistered precision or temporal-disjointness contract.

livecodebench_code_generation_lite.role: temporal function-level source candidate and external guardrail

evalplus.role: E2 external code retention and transfer guardrail only

forbidden_reactions: lower the frozen task-count requirement because current sources are insufficient
change the practical margin after observing source availability or model outcomes
treat non-temporal external guardrails as the primary temporal aggregate
use Utility or executable outcomes in Stage B
allowed_next_actions: continue forward acquisition of post-training-window temporal tasks under a frozen rule
prevalidate E2 execution support at task acquisition time
abstain until the frozen primary task-distribution contract is met
preregister a separate lower-power or narrower-claim study without altering this study retroactively
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Primary-source feasibility decision only; no Utility, curation-benefit, or release claim.
